scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n api,web -c red,white "npm run start:dev -w @nevhub/api" "npm run dev -w @nevhub/web"
scripts.build: dotenv -e .env -- npm run build -w @nevhub/api && dotenv -e .env -- npm run build -w @nevhub/web
scripts.start: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n api,web -c red,white "npm run start -w @nevhub/api" "npm run start -w @nevhub/web"
scripts.setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
